exact_statement:
On a finite fair physical restriction tree, D_v<=C*d_v+Q_v-E[Q_child|v], E Q_root<=K*B and E[H(leaf)-Q_leaf]<=L*E I(leaf), where B=E sum queried d, imply H(f)<=max(C+K,L)*I(f). The explicit terminal-corrected reserve Q_v=H(g_v)-E[H(leaf)|v] has exact drift D, is nonnegative and has zero leaves. For arbitrary-core point activation F=1+A_r(g-1), p=2^-r, a=1-Eg, control-first Q_root<=8*r*p*a with terminal entropy pH(g) retained. Activated arbitrary bent point-splice cores on even k>=4, r>=1 have separate terminal constant below 3 and reserve certificates at 8 for control-first and 9 for selector-first. The fixed candidates c*eta*log2(1/eta) and c*I_remaining*depth fail on B05 selector roots for every fixed finite c,C>=0 (history c=0 reduces to local failure); CI-H has the wrong payment drift except at D<=C*d. No universal root resource bound or full FEI is claimed.

Additional version-2 theorem: For any finite uniform exclusive controller selecting independent disjoint Boolean cores u_j or constants, with duplicate descriptions of the same physical core merged, keep control probabilities q_j fixed during a finite adaptive data-only prefix. Suppose each core follows a prescribed finite continuation tree with a nonnegative C-priced potential r_j depending only on its own history and an initially fixed independent seed. Then R_t=sum_j q_j*r_j(t)+sum_j q_j*log2(1/q_j)*Var(u_j,t) is a nonnegative potential at price alpha=C+11/2: D_F<=alpha*d_F+R_t-E[R_next|history]. Its initial value is at most sum_j q_j*r_j(root)+2I_ctrl(F); at any partial stop sigma, E R_sigma<=R_root+C*Pi_I,data. If cores are exhausted to constants with zero core leaf reserves, R_sigma=0, while the actual remaining controller entropy is retained. Thus the least nonnegative alpha-priced prefix reserve is dominated by R_root. For a declared controller continuation on each actual complete-data frontier, let b_sigma dominate its reserve at the same alpha; adding E[b_sigma|history] grafts a valid full-rule potential with root bound sum_j q_j*r_j(root)+2I_ctrl(F)+E b_sigma. No linear bound on the last debit or arbitrary inherited core reserve is assumed. The positive outer bank uses kappa=(3+2/e)/ln2<11/2; the coherent scalar paird refund is nonnegative and is removed only as an upper bound, never from the exact identity. For arbitrary h and two independent dictator data cores, data-first retained entropy, influence and consistently sign-translated declared controller reserve equal H(h)/2, I(h)/2, Q_alpha(h,T)/2. The new lift does not imply universal FEI.
